reviewScope: Read-only independent check of root canvas/layout/loading additions and current draw-description diff; no product files, card, ledger or quality configuration changed. Focused risk review, not a full-file governance closure.

findings.counter: The actual translated item description group12746 includes Atk+28 U+3000 Agi+12 U+3000 Def+3. SMALL_FONT initially covers U+0020..U+007F only; renderColoredText substitutes 16x16 TOFU for U+3000 while description row step is10. Isolated rendering lights y151..166 rather than within an8-pixel row.
findings.actualCaller: getScriptDescLines for every item/spell scriptDesc after setGlobalEvents(actual all.json)+setEnglishMessages(actual en.json); 46 catalog entries have missing small-font U+3000, and no other missing character is present in these actual description callers.
findings.rootResolutionPlan: Add a16-pixel-wide,8-pixel-high blank U+3000 glyph and actual attribute-line pixel regression; preserve full-width spacing and control-code semantics, no NFKC.

findings.counter: Settlement construction caches getWord role/magic names into screen.data.name/magicName. Switching effective language after screen creation leaves those strings in the old language while render-time level/stat/Up labels use the new one. Existing roleId provides a stable numeric lookup; learned-magic data previously lacked the corresponding numeric ID.
findings.rootResolutionPlan: Resolve role display name from supplied playerRoles using screen.data.roleId at draw time; retain optional magicId in learned-magic display data and validate its optional save projection. Add a real caller red/green switch-after-creation test. No claim of a browser observation is made here.

supportedConclusions.claim: Current status background transformation exactly matches independently transcribed SDLPal uigame.c1092-1120 memcpy placement over original FBP.MKF chunk0 and supported SLF layout positions53..58. All64000 indices agree; original source remains unchanged.
supportedConclusions.boundary: Raw file proves pixel source; SDLPal is the reference for translation-specific relocation, not proof of original executable visual behavior.

supportedConclusions.claim: Current equipment-label background cleanup matches full SDLPal uigame.c1825-1855 transformation over original FBP.MKF chunk1 with supported SLF EquipImageBox=(8,8). All64000 indices agree; source remains unchanged.
supportedConclusions.boundary: The TS helper omits the72x72 image-box relocation loop; for this protected source the loop erases/restores at the same8,8 and is byte-equivalent. A future different EquipImageBox location invalidates this acceptance and requires adding/testing that loop.

supportedConclusions.claim: All128 source8x8 row strings exactly match reference/sdlpal/ascii.h basic-Latin data. The LSB-to-MSB reversal matches font.c559-570 bit1<<j drawing and the project MSB-left Glyph contract.
supportedConclusions.boundary: Does not establish coverage for Unicode outside the basic-Latin table; CANVAS-01 demonstrated that gap.

supportedConclusions.claim: Layout bit0 small-font / bit1 disable-shadow matches palcfg.h178-179; IDs1..26 equip and27..80 status align with the supplied SLF. Chinese layoutPosition returns the original fallback object and layoutFont returns supplied Chinese font; English-only background branches leave Chinese source untouched.

Actual extracted item/spell _name fields and all role name pointers agree with the Chinese flat WORD table. Reviewed render-time getWord replacements therefore preserve current Chinese names. Known role ordering uses role.name directly, including Queen/AhNu swapped word pointers.

Actual raw glyphs/UI/backgrounds with a single already-created main menu, status state and equip pick-role state render zh-CN -> en -> zh-CN without rebuilding those state objects. Each changes pixels in English, restores the exact Chinese64000-byte frame hash, and leaves serialized GameState/menu input unchanged.
supportedConclusions.boundary: Offscreen functional rendering under fixed Date.now=0; no browser/E2E/manual visual credit.

supportedConclusions.claim: loadEnglishLanguage fetches no en.json for a Chinese-only manifest and rejects an advertised503 or invalid duplicate group. Bootstrap publishes an empty overlay and useFallbackLanguage on loading failure. useFallbackLanguage changes effective state without writing localStorage; initializeLanguage can recover the persisted en preference.
supportedConclusions.boundary: Loader and preference module tests plus bootstrap source review; no new live-network failure/browser test performed.

finiteVerification.oracle: Original C byte-copy loops+known SLF positions for background; independent raw source glyph rows; exact locale roundtrip frame hashes/unchanged inputs; expected actual glyph bounding height for CANVAS-01.
finiteVerification.dedupe: No new canonical tests added by reviewer; finite existing checks plus narrowly scoped source-backed probes, not a repeated package/full coverage run.

followupRecheck.expected: Read focused fix and caller/save projection changes, inspect native red/green tests and independently rerun only the affected pixel/settlement evidence if needed.
